question_text: How are PFAS samples preconcentrated before mass spectrometry, and how do protocols vary by matrix, analyte, or method?

question_components.description: Identify how PFAS samples are preconcentrated prior to mass spectrometry analysis, including specific extraction and enrichment steps
Describe how preconcentration protocols differ by sample matrix (e.g., wastewater, groundwater, soil, sludge, experimental solutions)
Describe how preconcentration protocols differ by PFAS analyte characteristics or target list
Describe how preconcentration protocols differ by analytical method or configuration (e.g., LC-MS/MS variants, use of SPE, WAX cartridges, QuEChERS)

question_text: What chain-length-related differences in PFAS analytical sensitivity or LOD/LOQ have been reported, and how do method or instrument settings affect them?

question_components.description: Reported differences in analytical sensitivity, limits of detection (LOD), or limits of quantification (LOQ) among PFAS as a function of chain length or related structural features (e.g., shorter vs longer perfluoroalkyl chains).
Influence of analytical method type (e.g., LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, sensors, SPE/dSPE/SPME, SBSE) on PFAS sensitivity or LOD/LOQ, including any chain-length-dependent effects.

Influence of specific instrument or method settings (e.g., ionization mode, calibration approach, sample matrix, preconcentration, sample volume, gradient, blanks handling) on PFAS sensitivity or LOD/LOQ, including any chain-length-dependent effects.

question_text: How do electrolyte composition and pH-control choices affect interpretation of PFAS removal or degradation experiments?

question_components.description: How electrolyte composition (ionic strength, ion type/valency, supporting electrolyte choice, background water matrix) influences observed PFAS removal or degradation rates and mechanisms, and thus the interpretation or comparability of experiments
How pH and pH-control strategies (including changes during treatment) influence PFAS removal or degradation behavior and interpretation of experimental results

question_text: What energy-consumption or energy-efficiency evidence is available for PFAS degradation methods, and can values be compared across studies?

question_components.description: Identify reported energy-consumption or energy-efficiency metrics for PFAS degradation/destruction methods, including values and how they are defined or normalized

Assess whether and how energy-consumption or energy-efficiency values for PFAS degradation methods can be compared across different studies, including any stated limitations or normalization approaches

question_text: How do reported activated-carbon PFAS adsorption capacities differ between batch and column studies?

question_components.description: Identify and compare reported PFAS adsorption capacities of activated carbon measured in batch studies versus column studies, noting any differences in magnitude, trends, or influencing factors.

question_text: What membrane-based PFAS treatment routes are described, and which routes separate or concentrate PFAS rather than destroy or transform them?

question_components.description: Identify the membrane-based PFAS treatment routes described in the literature (e.g., filtration, NF, RO, membrane distillation, forward osmosis, electrodialysis, membrane capacitive deionization, membrane-assisted degradation, photocatalytic membrane reactors, etc.)
Determine which of the described membrane-based routes primarily separate or concentrate PFAS into a secondary stream or waste fraction rather than directly destroying or transforming PFAS

question_text: When comparing membrane filtration, gliding arc plasma, and supercritical water oxidation for PFAS treatment, which reported endpoints should be kept separate?

question_components.description: Identify and distinguish the different types of reported performance or outcome endpoints used to evaluate PFAS treatment by membrane filtration, gliding arc plasma, and supercritical water oxidation, in order to determine which endpoints should not be directly compared or combined across these technologies.

question_text: When screening activated-carbon or biochar PFAS adsorption studies, what matrix and regeneration gaps should be checked?

question_components.description: Identify which water or wastewater matrices are underrepresented or missing in activated-carbon or biochar PFAS adsorption studies and should be checked as potential matrix gaps during screening.

Identify which aspects of adsorbent regeneration, reuse, or reactivation (including methods, feasibility, and conditions) are under-studied or missing in activated-carbon or biochar PFAS adsorption studies and should be checked as regeneration gaps during screening.

question_text: How should contact time be planned when powder activated carbon is used for both short- and long-chain PFAS?

question_components.description: Identify how contact time should be planned or selected when using powder activated carbon (PAC) to remove both short- and long-chain PFAS, including any differences in required contact times or equilibration behavior between chain lengths.

question_text: Under what conditions might supercritical water oxidation leave uncertainty about fluorinated products?

question_components.description: Identify SCWO operating conditions (e.g., temperature, pressure, residence time, oxidant level, PFAS class) under which there is incomplete mineralization or delayed fluoride recovery, leaving uncertainty about the identity or fate of fluorinated products or intermediates.

question_text: How does PFAS chain length affect reported treatment performance or adsorption behavior?

question_components.description: Describe how PFAS perfluoroalkyl chain length influences adsorption strength, removal efficiency, or breakthrough behavior for adsorption-based treatment processes (e.g., GAC, IX, other adsorbents), including any reported trends or mechanisms.
Describe how PFAS perfluoroalkyl chain length influences treatment performance in non-adsorptive separation processes (e.g., nanofiltration), including any reported trends or mechanisms.

question_text: How can PFAS compound class or headgroup affect treatment performance or equilibrium behavior?

question_components.description: How PFAS compound class or headgroup (e.g., PFCA vs PFSA, fluorotelomer vs perfluoroalkyl, functional group identity) influences treatment performance such as adsorption strength, breakthrough behavior, removal efficiency, or competitive adsorption in treatment systems
How PFAS compound class or headgroup influences equilibrium or partitioning behavior, including sorption strength, mobility, and equilibrium adsorption in treatment media or environmental matrices

question_text: Does longer empty-bed contact time necessarily translate into better PFAS performance in granular activated carbon systems?

question_components.description: Determine how changes in empty-bed contact time (EBCT) or contact time affect PFAS removal performance in granular activated carbon (GAC) fixed-bed systems, including whether performance continues to improve with longer EBCT or reaches a plateau or shows no further benefit.
